run_app_streamlit: run the streamlit app using run_app.py as the entry point script
run_app_streamlit_headless: run the streamlit app in headless mode with no file watcher
run_app_with_args: run the streamlit app and pass extra arguments through to the app
run_app_from_subprocess: run the streamlit app via subprocess from a Python script
run_app_resolve_path: run the streamlit app resolving app.py relative to the script directory
